vision.title: The Vision
vision.description: "To work towards the social, educational and economic progress of each individual in the family and thereby devise and implement activities aimed at the comprehensive progress of the society and, consequently, the country."

item_1.title: Unity in Diversity
item_1.message: Celebrating our individual paths while staying rooted in one home.

item_2.title: Education
item_2.message: Investing in the intellectual growth of our youth.

item_3.title: Tradition
item_3.message: Preserving the rituals and stories that define us.

future_promise.title: Our Promise to the Future
future_promise.message: We assure you that our history will inspire generations to come. Our family will always exist in love and unity.
